about: Reference data and tools of run-vallado.mjs, in user space under /Users/tj/software/tools/xval/sgp4-vallado. Test oracles only; nothing here ships.

sgp4/SGP4-VER.TLE.what: Vallado's 33 verification sets (near-Earth, deep space, resonant, decaying, error cases), each with start, stop and step minutes

sgp4/tcppver.out.what: Vallado's testcpp output for those sets: TEME km (%16.8f) and km/s (%12.9f), WGS-72; 700 lines, 666 data rows on 32 sets that start

extension/SGP4.cpp.note: Vallado's SGP4.cpp (12 mar 20). Identical, line endings aside, to propagator/sgp4/src/cpp/src/SGP4.cpp; SGP4.h likewise (ec22575c...5741 without CR)

reference.errorCodes: python-sgp4's test_legacy_against_tcppver: Vallado's code returns 1, 1, 6, 6, 4, 3, 6, in that order, while producing tcppver.out

opsmode: tcppver.out is Vallado's improved mode ('i'), the mode the module uses: the 'a' (AFSPC) mode moves deep-space sets by up to 964 m (23599 at 460 min)

emcc.flags: the module's CMake flags (-O3 -flto -ffast-math -msimd128) and the same without -ffast-math
emcc.note: Not the module's toolchain (emsdk 6.0.1): used to isolate what -ffast-math does to SGP4.cpp in wasm, not to reproduce the shipped bytes

module.surface: ingest_omm ($OMM from the TLE text, epoch as an ISO string with the day fraction written out exactly) and propagate_state (output_frame TEME, epoch = the set's Julian date + tsince / 1440 in one double)

ussfSgp4Xp.reason: The US Space Force's own baseline outputs ship only in the Astro Standards packages on Space-Track. None is on this machine; third_party/ussf-sgp4 holds the C Sgp4Prop wasm package (v9.1.1.0, XP build), whose zip carries no verification cases. The release notes state that XP results of the C library differ from the Fortran baseline (SHADOW computation).
ussfSgp4Xp.existing: propagator/sgp4-xp/vectors (vectors.json, PROVENANCE.md): the module against the unmodified USSF wasm at 0, 90 and 1440 min on five XP sets, 2.3 cm; this checks the adapter, not the XP theory
